annotations.title: Fundraising Readiness: Data Room Score, Runway and Burn Multiple

description: Scores diligence readiness from a weighted 12-item data room checklist (overall, Corporate and Legal, and each pillar), and computes runway and burn multiple from cash, burn and ARR growth. Same scoring as https://modevc.com/tools/fundraising-readiness. The investor-update email draft on that page is not included.

cash.description: Cash in the bank in USD. Web default 1,450,000.

documents_ready.description: Checklist items that are ready. Omit to use the web calculator example (all except valuation_409a, retention_cohorts, architecture_and_security). Pass [] for none.

mom_growth_pct.description: Month over month ARR growth in percent. Web default 18.

monthly_net_burn.description: Monthly net burn in USD. Web default 65,000.
monthly_net_burn.zeroNote: the web calculator replaces 0 with its default

raise_target.description: Raise target in USD (echoed, not used in the score). Web default 3,500,000.
